cycles.explanation: Miami, Ohio State, Ole Miss, Georgia, Texas, Texas A&M, Notre Dame, Texas Tech, BYU, Utah, Iowa State, TCU, SMU, Louisville, Houston, Arizona, Arizona State, Pittsburgh, NC State, Georgia Tech, Wake Forest and Virginia form a loop: following every head-to-head result among them leads back to where it started, so no ordering can honour all 47 of them. The weakest link was Arizona State's 26-22 win over Texas Tech (a 4-point win at home is worth +1.6 once venue is accounted for; the winner rates 12.0 points worse on the power ratings; the loser fared better against 3 shared opponents), so it was set aside, along with 6 other results in this loop.

USC, Michigan, Washington and Illinois form a loop: following every head-to-head result among them leads back to where it started, so no ordering can honour all 4 of them. The weakest link was Illinois's 34-32 win over USC (a 2-point win at home is worth -0.4 once venue is accounted for; the winner rates 5.2 points worse on the power ratings; the loser fared better against 2 shared opponents), so it was set aside.

source.attribution: Data: CollegeFootballData.com -- betting lines, play-by-play PPA, and Strength of Record, Strength of Schedule and FPI via ESPN

stages: Stage 1 - rank every team by what it has achieved and how good it is: 0.6 x Strength of Record + 0.25 x market neutral-field rank + 0.15 x opponent-adjusted points added per play (all national ranks, lower is better).
Stage 2 - adjust for how your losses actually look: the venue and margin of each defeat, the quality of your best win, and how comfortably you win.
Stage 3 - when a result spans more than 15 places, pull both teams 0.5 of the way to their midpoint; the upset says both were mis-rated.
Stage 4 - reorder so as few head-to-head results as possible are contradicted, weighing each result by how convincing it was against how far a team would have to move.
Stage 5 - report every contradiction loop and every overridden result, so nothing is hidden.
methodology.summary: base = 0.6 x SoR + 0.25 x Mkt + 0.15 x PPA; pool 40; H2H strength 14, drift exponent 1.5; upset regression on (gap 15, 0.5)
